project_title: VOIDWARE Storefront Redesign - Deep Navy GetCheats.gg Cinematic Style
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / DEEP NAVY CINEMATIC
emotional_tone: Tactical, high-tech, dominant, slick, trusted, cinematic gaming authority

theme_strategy.glow_effects: Deep blue ambient glows (rgba(46, 107, 255, 0.25)) with subtle radial lights

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk (sans-serif) - 700 to 900 weight, tight tracking (tracking-tight)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (monospace) - for prices, stats, status badges, timers, keys
rules: Headings MUST NOT use Inter or Roboto
Main Hero H1 maximum size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with font-extrabold tracking-tight
Overlines/Badges MUST be uppercase with letter spacing tracking-widest
Section Headings H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl
Price Tags & Numbers: use font-mono font-bold

header_nav.style: Fixed floating bar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050B18]/80 border-b border-[#1E2D4A] z-50
header_nav.structure: Logo left ('VOIDWARE' with royal blue electric mark), Nav Links center ('Cheats / Products', 'Status', 'Order Lookup', 'Hype Drop'), Cart Icon + Account / Admin right
header_nav.rules: No complete transparency. Must have explicit border and blurred deep navy backdrop.

hero_section.left_col: Headline 'Get the Upper Hand' with a vertical or horizontal blue accent line indicator, small bold sub-heading, description text, Dual CTA buttons (Solid Blue Primary 'Explore Cheats' + Dark Navy Outlined Secondary 'Order Lookup'), and Stat Row below (Years Active, Satisfied Gamers, Undetected Products)
hero_section.right_col: Large high-res cinematic gamer / tactical character render floating on the right with dark blue spotlight duotone halo behind it
hero_section.overlay: Soft blue gradient scrim from left and bottom to prevent background text blend

shop_grid.card_aspect_ratio: Tall Portrait Cards (~3:4 aspect ratio) with full-bleed game/character artwork
shop_grid.card_design: Subtle dark navy card background (#0F1F38) with 1px border (#1E2D4A). On hover, border lights up to Electric Blue (#2E6BFF) with subtle -translate-y-1 lift and glow shadow. Card bottom contains gradient scrim with Game Title, Status Badge ('Undetected'), 'From €X.XX' price tag, and a circular electric blue arrow CTA button on bottom-right.
shop_grid.grid_layout: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8

product_modal.style: Multi-duration selector (1 Day, 7 Days, 30 Days, Lifetime), key features list (Aimbot, ESP, Radar, HWID Spoofer), instant delivery badge, add to cart & instant buy buttons

hype_drop_page.style: Teaser trailer vibe with massive JetBrains Mono digital countdown timer, blurred teaser artwork, email waitlist capture form with instant email confirmation state

cart_drawer.style: Slide-over drawer with item summary, duration choice toggle, guest checkout email field, instant Stripe integration trigger, license key delivery options

buttons.primary: bg-[#2E6BFF] hover:bg-[#1D55E0] text-white font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(46,107,255,0.4)] transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0A1628] hover:bg-[#0F1F38] text-slate-200 border border-[#1E2D4A] hover:border-[#2E6BFF]/50 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200
buttons.arrow_button: w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#2E6BFF] hover:bg-[#1D55E0] text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-transform hover:scale-110

cards.portrait_product_card: relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#0A1628] border border-[#1E2D4A] hover:border-[#2E6BFF]/60 transition-all duration-300 group hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-lg hover:shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(46,107,255,0.2)]

badges.undetected: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-mono uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5
badges.updating: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs font-mono uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll enabled in App.js
motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Framer Motion for page fade transitions, modal scale-ups, cart drawer slide-ins, and staggered grid loading
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards must include subtle scale/lift micro-interactions and explicitly defined text color states

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js and src/index.css to implement the deep navy/midnight blue palette (#050B18 base, #0A1628 surface, #2E6BFF royal blue accent) replacing any residual black/cyan theme.
Restyle the Header navigation bar with floating backdrop-blur-xl deep navy styling.

Redesign the Home Hero section with left-aligned headline 'Get the Upper Hand', royal blue accent line, Dual CTAs, quick stats row, and right-aligned cinematic character render with blue halo lighting.
Transform the product shop grid to use tall 3:4 portrait cards with full-bleed game/character artwork, status badge, price from tag, and circular blue arrow button.
Implement the Hype Drop page route (/drop) with large digital countdown timer, blurred teaser art, and email waitlist subscription form.
Ensure all components and buttons include data-testid attributes and high-contrast readable states.
Validate that cart drawer, checkout modal, order lookup, and admin panel match the polished navy theme.
